text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

INDIA, July 8 - Bombay - No labour problems. Six vessels loading at berth, 22 discharging at berth, 2 discharging at anchorage. 4 Vessels waiting at anchorage to load, 6 waiting to discharge, 1 under repair, 2 awaiting orders. Berthing delays, container vessels 1-2 days, bulkers 8-10 days, general cargo vessels 3-4 days. Calcutta - Seven vessels loading at berth, 20 discharging at berth, 1 discharging at anchorage, 2 bunkering. 19 Vessels due (2 coking coal, 6 products tankers, 6 containers, 1 crude oil, 2 tneb coal, 1 limestone, 1 logs). Cochin - No labour problems. Heavy monsoon rains. Three vessels loading at berth, 5 discharging at berth, 1 waiting at anchorage to discharge, 2 under repair of which 1 at CSL jetty and one tanker at repair dock. 1 Vessel awaiting orders, 15 due with up to 1 day's delay expected.

Chennai (Madras) - Five vessels loading at berth, 10 discharging at berth, 1 waiting at anchorage to load, 3 waiting to discharge. 29 Vessels due (7 coal, 4 general cargo, 2 fertiliser, 2 iron ore, 2 barytes, 8 containers, 1 palm oil, 1 felspar, 1 stone, 1 other vessel). Berthing delays, fertiliser/scrap 5-6 days, no delays for containers, coal/coke/iron ore/others 2-3 days. Mormugao - No labour problems. One vessel loading at berth, 1 discharging at berth, 1 waiting at anchorage to load, 1 dry-docked, 1 awaiting orders. 4 Vessels due (2 ore, 1 alumina, 1 containers) with no delays expected. Kandla - Four vessels loading at berth, 4 discharging at berth, 3 discharging in stream, 3 tankers. 11 Vessels waiting at anchorage to load, 2 under arrest, 9 due with 15-16 days berthing delay expected.

Mangalore - No labour problems. Heavy continuous rain. Three vessels loading/discharging at berth, 2 awaiting berths, 1 under repair, 1 under arrest. 9 Vessels due with 2-3 days berthing delay expected. Jawaharlal Nehru - No labour problems. Three vessels discharging at berth (2 fertiliser/raw materials/food grain, 1 tanker/iron ore vessel), 1 iron ore vessel discharging at anchorage. 5 Vessels waiting at anchorage to discharge (1 tanker/iron ore vessel, 4 fertiliser/raw materials/food grain vessels). 7 Vessels due (1 dap, 6 tanker/iron ore vessels) with followg berthing delays, urea 18-20 days, other fertiliser 35-40 days, tankers/iron ore vessels 3-4 days. Paradip - No labour problems. Three vessels loading at berth, 1 discharging at berth, 3 waiting at anchorage to load, 9 due, with 4 days delay expected.

Tuticorin - No labour problems. 53 Vessels loading at berth, 55 discharging at berth, 26 discharging at anchorage. 3 Vessels waiting at anchorage to load, 1 awaiting orders, 4 due with 1-2 days delay expected. Visakhapatnam - No labour problems. Six vessels loading at berth, 9 discharging at berth, 12 waiting at anchorage to discharge at inner harbour berth, 9 waiting to load at inner harbour berth. 23 Vessels due, with 7-8 days delay expected.

MALAYSIA, July 9 - Port Kelang - North/south port - Container/ro-ro berth - 10 Vessels berthed, 8 waiting with 3 days delay. Deep draft conventional wharf - 4 Vessels berthed, 3 berthing 9/7. 6 Waiting with 3 days waiting time. Dry/cement bulk terminal - 4 Vessels berthed, 3 waiting with 4 days waiting time. Liquid bulk terminal - 4 Vessels berthed, 2 waiting with 1 day's waiting time. West port - Container/ro-ro berth - 2 Vessels berthed, none waiting with no delays. Deep draft conventional wharf - 6 Vessels berthed, 6 waiting with 3 days waiting time. Cement bulk terminal - 1 Vessels berthed, none waiting, no delays. Liquid bulk terminal - No vessel berthed, none waiting, no delays.

MAURITIUS, July 8 - Port Louis - Labour working normally. All berths occupied. Nine vessels berthed of which 5 containers, 4 general cargo, all discharging/loading. 3 Vessels awaiting berths, 1-2 days berthing delay expected, no idle vessels.

PHILIPPINES, July 7 - Manila - South harbour - 11 Vessels discharging at berth, 8 discharging at inner anchorage berth, 23 waiting at outside anchore to discharge, 4 others awaiting orders etc. Average waiting times - Vessels with draft less than 8 metres and loa less than 130 metres 2-3 days, vessels with draft more than 9 metres and loa more than 140 metres 3-5 days.

SINGAPORE, July 8 - Singapore - Tanjong Pagar container terminal - 11 Container vessels berthed. Keppel terminal - 2 Container/general cargo vessels berthed. Pasir Panjang terminal - 10 Container/general cargo vessels berthed. Sembawang terminal - 2 General cargo vessels berthed. Jurong port - 2 Bulk cargo/steel/general cargo vessels berthed. Oil terminals/sbm buoys - 22 Tanker berthed, minimal berthing delays at all terminals/ports/buoys. Showers expected this week late morning and early afternoon.

SOUTH KOREA, July 8 - Inchon - 73 Vessels in port (44 berthed, 29 anchored) of which berthed 13 logs, 5 general cargo, 4 pig-iron, 4 containers, 3 corn, 2 steel, 2 cars, 2 coils, 2 scrap, 1 silica sand, 1 tapioca, 1 wheat blending pellet, 1 copper, 1 maize, 1 soya beans, 1 fertiliser. Vessels anchored, 5 cars, 4 general cargo, 3 corn, 3 logs, 3 steel, 3 containers, 2 wheat, 2 scrap, 2 raw sugar, 1 ilmenite, 1 pulp. Approx. 1-2 days berthing delay expected. Busan - 154 Vessels in port (42 berthed, 112 anchored including 55 laid-up) of which berthed, 29 general cargo, 8 containers, 3 scrap, 2 coal. 57 Vessels awaiting berths, approx. 1-2 days delay expected.

Pohang - 22 Vessels port (19 berthed, 3 anchored) of which berthed and discharging, 5 steel products, 3 steel scrap, 3 clinker, 1 logs. Vessels loading, 6 steel, 1 graphite. 3 Vessels awaiting berths, approx. 1-2 days delay expected. Ulsan - 21 Vessels in port (20 berthed, 1 anchored), of which berthed and discharging, 2 logs, 1 feed meal, 1 poly propylene, 1 styrene monomer, 1 mono ethyl glycol, 1 wood-chips, 1 corn, 1 crude oil, 1 paraxylene. Vessels loading, 3 general cargo, 2 steel pipes, 1tyrene monomer, 1 fertiliser, 1 resin, 1 hexanol, 1 chemicals. 1 Vessel awaiting berth, approx. 1 day's delay expected.

Masan - 14 Vessels in port (12 berthed, 2 anchored) of which berthed and discharging, 6 scrap, 2 tapioca, 1 logs). Vessels loading, 1 steel pipes, 1 containers, 1 cigarettes. 2 Vessels awaiting berths, approx. 1-2 days delay expected.

SRI LANKA, July 8 - Colombo - Labour shortage persists. Berthing/unberthing delays experienced on break bulk and conventional vessels. SW monsoonal rains. 22 Vessels loading at berth (2 essential services, 18 containers, 2 general cargo). 26 Discharging at berth (2 bagged sugar, 17 containers, 1 essential services, 1 lpg, 1 bagged cement, 3 general cargo, 1 bagged urea). 15 Vessels waiting at anchorage to discharge (12 containers (feeders), 1 bulk mop, 1 bagged fertiliser, 1 bagged cement). 5 Vessels bunkering, 1 under repair, 7 under arrest, 7 awaiting orders from principals, 1 changing crew. 14 Vessels due of which 12 containers/feeders, 2 ro-ros. Berthing delays, general cargo 2-3 days, containers (feeders) 24 hours. Galle - Two vessels discharging at berth. Trincomalee - One vessel discharging at berth, 2 loading at berth.

TAIWAN, July 7 - Keelung - Four vessels anchored. Berthing delays, grain 4 days, coal 8 days, steel/iron ore 3 days. Kaohsiung - Eight vessels anchored. Berthing delays, grain 5 days, iron/coal 3 days (CSC berth), coal/scrap 7 days (public berth), steel 2 days. Taichung - Seven vessels anchored. Berthing delays, grain 10-14 days, iron ore/coal/scrap/steel/others 1 day. Keelung - July 8 - 25 Vessels in port of which 11 containers, 1 tanker, 1 grain, 1 other bulker, 11 general cargo. 6 Vessels waiting at outer anchorage (5 containers, 1 tanker). Berthing delays, containers 12 hours, tankers 1 day.
